div.div:
What triggers a new assignment?
New urgent detection • aircraft unavailable • energy margin shrinking • finished strip • fresh weather / airspace constraint
Flight controllers continue at their own rate while this slower mission loop runs. Avoid reassignment thrashing.

A camera candidate is not a confirmed survivor. Package release is not confirmed receipt. Receipt is not extraction.
Ground teams and human review close the relevant incident outcome.
